summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon with WebSocket-driven local execution and PTY on installer host
details: Package installs a CLI daemon (`whalent`) that opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded vendor gateway and accepts remote commands (documented as `upgrade`, `restart`, and analogous control operations) that reach local execution paths on the installer's host. Runtime dependencies include `ws`, `node-pty`, `ssh2`, and `@xterm/headless`, and the shipped `dist/core.cjs` (14 MB) contains both `WebSocket` and `spawn` symbols — the network-to-local-execution shape of a remote-agent backdoor with full-host RCE blast radius. The main bundle `dist/core.cjs` and `dist/index.cjs` are heavily obfuscated with `javascript-obfuscator` (rotating string array, control-flow flattening, hex-encoded identifiers such as `_0x3a15c6`, `_0x22eb51`), which frustrates independent verification of what the gateway is actually authorized to drive on the host. The remote party holds control of what executes; the surface encompasses arbitrary shell/PTY operations regardless of the vendor's stated intent, and the obfuscation prevents confirming the command surface is limited to the documented `upgrade`/`restart` operations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
